## Who I am

I'm **Avinash Reddy**, a full-stack engineer with three years of
production experience, now pursuing an **MSc in Business Analytics** at
**Dublin City University** (expected 2026).

My career so far has been about building systems that work reliably at
scale. My next chapter is about building systems that help organisations
**decide better** - where good engineering meets rigorous analytics.

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
### TL;DR
Three years developing web applications for enterprise and government
clients. Currently combining that engineering foundation with formal
analytics training to move into **data-driven product and decision roles**.
:::

## Why this transition

As an engineer, I saw the same pattern repeatedly: teams sit on
**rich data** but make calls on **thin intuition**. Dashboards get built,
nobody uses them, and the next decision is made the same way as the last
one.

I chose the MSc at DCU because I want the **statistical and modelling
depth** to not just move data around, but to reason with it - and the
engineering background to turn that reasoning into something
**production-ready**, not a one-off notebook.

## What I bring

### Engineering
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript - accessibility-aware, performance-budgeted
- **Backend:** Node.js, Django, FastAPI - REST APIs, type-safe contracts
- **Data layer:** PostgreSQL, BigQuery - query optimisation, schema design
- **Infra:** Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS - reproducible deployments

### Analytics (growing)
- **Python data stack:** pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Plotly
- **Statistical reasoning:** hypothesis testing, distributions, non-parametric methods
- **Quarto & reproducibility:** executable reports, version-controlled analysis
- **SQL for analysis:** window functions, CTEs, BigQuery at scale
